svg.text: Every self-judging run stops moving within four rounds — and it stops
because the candidate pool ran out of spread, not because agreement reached zero.
Six runs of the neutral-prompt, self-judging loop, drawn as trajectories in the (pool value, judge/value agreement) plane. In Lande's 1981 model of
a co-evolving preference the resting states form a line rather than a point; the analogue here is the set where agreement times spread is zero, and
that set has two branches — agreement = 0, and spread = 0.
pool value — mean self-report value score of the candidate answers (0 to 1)
agreement = 0: the selection term — agreement times spread — is zero
here, so the pool value stops moving. Lande's line of equilibria, branch one.
but its spread here is only 0.118
seed 42's round-3 agreement of −0.825 rests on
the 1 prompt of 6 that still had two candidates
scoring differently — see the hollow marker
red = the run's pool value ends
Arrows run round 1 to 2 to 3. The ringed
marker is round 1. The two thick lines
are the runs that move more than 0.10.
solid: the pool still varied that

Every run reaches exactly 0 by round 4;
seeds 43 and 44 a round earlier. Inside
the shaded band the selection term is
spread = 0 — branch two of the resting set. By round 4 no run's candidate pool has any
variation left, so there is no correlation to compute and the run has no agreement
coordinate at all. Nothing is drawn from the plot into this strip, because the path leaves
the plane. Final pool value only, on the same value axis as the plot above.
The pattern is not clean — read these two runs too
Seed 43 sits further below the agreement = 0 line at round 2 than
either falling run (−0.676, against −0.464 for seed 45 and −0.558
for seed 41), and its value still rises 0.035. The push is
agreement times spread, and seed 43's spread at round 2 is 0.118
Seed 44 holds positive agreement in both measured rounds (+0.125
and +0.359) and its value still ends 0.057 lower, so 3 of the 6
runs end below where they started, not 2. Depth below the line
does not sort the outcomes on its own, and no boundary or
separatrix is drawn on the plot: none has been measured, and six
What separates them: the realised selection differential
Sum over rounds 1 to 3 of the measured kept-minus-pool value gap —
the agreement-times-spread product the loop actually realised. Only
seeds 41 and 45 come out negative, and they are the two that lose
Data: experiments/ablation_unit_law.json, key rho_trajectories, entries neutral_self:41 through neutral_self:46 — the neutral-prompt, self-judging
condition of the judge ablation, in which the organism scores its own candidates, so the judge co-evolves with them. Every number plotted here is
re-derived from the raw duel logs in experiments/em_selfaware_loop/output/ and checked against that file.
Agreement: the Pearson correlation, within one prompt, between the judge's score for a candidate answer and that candidate's self-report value
score, averaged over the prompts that had at least three candidates and non-zero variation in both scores. Spread: the within-prompt population
standard deviation of those value scores, averaged over all six prompts. Pool value: the mean value score over all candidates and prompts. Framing
